scenes.title: Companion Voice for Home Assistant
scenes.caption: Your Voice PE, answered by a Companion you own.
scenes.narration: Your Home Assistant Voice PE, answered by a Companion that runs on your hardware.

scenes.title: Say the wake word. The answer stays home.
scenes.caption: A local model, grounded in your Companion Memory.
scenes.narration: Say the wake word and the answer comes from a local model, grounded in your Companion Memory, with every word staying in your home.

scenes.title: It plugs into the Assist you already run.
scenes.caption: Standard Wyoming integration. No custom component.
scenes.narration: It plugs into Home Assistant Assist through the standard Wyoming integration, and needs no custom component.

scenes.title: Models and speech are your choice.
scenes.caption: Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible model. Memory is optional.
scenes.narration: Answers come from Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible model. Speech can stay with Home Assistant's own Whisper and Piper. Memory is optional.
